summary: TOOL-1 Login with valid and invalid credentials
description:
As a customer, I want to sign in so I can access my account.

* Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
* Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
* Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.
* Password field masks the input.

criteria.text: Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.

cases.title: Sign in with a valid email and password
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email and password> exists. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the email of <a registered customer account with a known email and password> in the email field.
Enter the correct password for that account in the password field.
cases.expected: The user is redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.

cases.title: Sign in with a wrong password
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email and password> exists. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the email of <a registered customer account with a known email and password> in the email field.
Enter <a password that is not the password of that account> in the password field.
cases.expected: An error message appears (exact text not specified in the story) and the user stays on the login page.

cases.title: Submit the login form with both fields empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
cases.expected: Each empty field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the email field empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter <any password value> in the password field.
cases.expected: The empty email field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the password field empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter <any email value> in the email field.
cases.expected: The empty password field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Password field masks the typed input
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Look at the characters shown in the password field.
cases.expected: The password field masks the input, so the typed characters are not shown as readable text.
